title: incident-bot: add SLO toolkit runbook quicklinks and on-call diagnostics helpers
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: improve on-call troubleshooting velocity by surfacing SLO-linked runbook quicklinks and adding lightweight diagnostics helpers for incident-bot to attach contextual runbooks to alerts. Summary: add a quicklinks provider in slo-toolkit that returns ranked runbook links for a given SLO or service identifier, integrate incident-bot to surface those quicklinks in on-call notifications and the /runbook command, and ship a small helper library to collect diagnostic context (recent alerts, top traces, recent deploys) for runbook templates. This PR includes: 1) slo-toolkit/src/quicklinks.py - quick matching and ranking logic with a small in-memory cache; 2) incident-bot integration that calls the quicklinks provider and renders compact runbook snippets with suggestions; 3) runbook template snippets and docs updates; 4) tests and CI coverage. Checklist: [x] unit tests for quicklinks scoring [x] integration test for incident-bot command [x] docs updated [x] feature flagged behind ONCALL_RUNBOOK_QUICKLINKS. Rollout plan: feature flag disabled by default, staged enable for SRE org then broader rollout after monitoring. Backwards compatibility: no breaking API changes. See linked Linear and Jira for rollout tasks and follow-ups.
